gloss: the side next to; the neighboring side; adjacent side

definitions.gloss: the side next to; the neighboring side; adjacent side
definitions.explanation: The side or area immediately next to something or someone. Used when specifying which side of an object, building, or space you are referring to.

examples.japanese: {隣側|となりがわ}の{席|せき}が{空|あ}いている。
examples.english: The seat on the adjacent side is empty.

examples.japanese: {壁|かべ}の{隣側|となりがわ}から{音楽|おんがく}が{聞|き}こえてくる。
examples.english: I can hear music from the other side of the wall.

examples.japanese: この{建物|たてもの}の{隣側|となりがわ}に{新|あたら}しいカフェがオープンする{予定|よてい}だ。
examples.english: A new café is scheduled to open on the side next to this building.

notes:
Formed from {隣|となり} (next to, adjacent) and {側|がわ} (side). Used to specify position relative to something. The {側|がわ} suffix is productive and attaches to many spatial words.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {隣側|となりがわ}の{部屋|へや}: the room on the adjacent side
- {隣側|となりがわ}に{座|すわ}る: to sit on the neighboring side
- {隣側|となりがわ}から: from the neighboring side

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {向|む}こう{側|がわ}: the other side, opposite side — across from the speaker, not adjacent
- {下側|したがわ}: lower side — same {側|がわ} pattern with a vertical direction
- {隣|となり}: next to — the base word without the {側|がわ} specification
